# MiniModel.MiRust.com

Developer documentation for MiniModel.com, `.slm`, and the metadata-only tiny model exchange architecture.

Read first:

- /docs/overview.md
- /docs/slm-format.md
- /docs/manifest-v0.md
- /docs/verifier-mvp.md
- /docs/source-lanes.md
- /docs/legal-boundary.md
- /docs/p2p-roadmap.md
- /docs/agent-readme.md
- /examples/minimodel.manifest.v0.example
- /examples/tiny-test-model-q8.minimodel.manifest.v0
- /examples/share-metadata.v0.json

Hard rules:

- Project servers never run user model bytes.
- Project servers never serve user model bytes.
- Project servers never proxy external model-byte downloads.
- MiniModel.com may serve docs, schemas, metadata, public-key routes, examples, and takedown/contact routes only.
- TinyRustLM.com remains browser-local.
- Users import local `.slm` files through the browser file picker.
- Rust owns `.slm` validation and checksum verification.
- The first `minimodel-core` and `minimodel` verifier crates are implemented in the MiniModel.org source workspace, including local peer-piece export/reassembly, direct known-peer serve/fetch/import, metadata-only catalog snapshots, `add-peer-source` for direct late peer availability, peer-source announcement/apply commands, and batch snapshot publication for maintainer-reviewed availability.
- Long-term memory stays pointer-based and checksum-bearing.

Source options:

- User local files: simplest path.
- Hugging Face: metadata discovery, local conversion-request JSON, optional local `.tinyrustlm-convert.ps1` script, `convert-huggingface-request`, MiniModel `prepare-peer-share`, optional `add-peer-source`, optional `write-peer-source-announcement`, optional TinyRustLM local peer-source announcement overlay, same-origin checksum-bound catalog announcement feeds, maintainer-side `apply-peer-source-announcements`, batch `write-catalog-snapshot-with-announcements`, metadata-only `write-catalog-snapshot`, and user-side acquisition context only; no Hub result is runnable until an admitted `.slm` exists.
- Local verifier: `cargo run -p minimodel -- verify-manifest`, `verify-artifact`, and `write-import-receipt` prove local `.slm` artifacts before TinyRustLM import.
- Local peer pieces: `export-peer-pieces`, `serve-peer-pieces`, `fetch-peer-pieces`, `assemble-peer-pieces`, and `import-peer-request` prove direct known-peer transfer and reassembly before broad P2P discovery exists.
- Local share metadata: after a verified local `.slm`, TinyRustLM can save `minimodel.local_slm_share_metadata.v0` with artifact SHA256, chunk SHA256 entries, chunk-list SHA256, Merkle root, and disabled live-transfer flags.
- Future P2P: broader discovery, relays, NAT traversal, and swarm transfer after local verifier, Rust `.minimodel-peer-offer` proof, share metadata, direct known-peer receipts, and legal boundary are stable.
